title: phagnalon geminiflorum var. annoticum
intro: Phagnalon geminiflorum var. annoticum, commonly known as Phagnalon annotinum, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, typically found in the Mediterranean region. It has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phagnalon annotinum are attributed to its ability to inhibit pro-inflammatory enzymes, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in the plant's aerial parts.
